name: Őriszentpéter (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, light blue at the hoist and white at the fly, charged at the centre with the town arms of Őriszentpéter: a blue shield with a white figure holding a sword on a green mound.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
